method: Native paired semantic-state tracing, source-position MLP contrast amplification, direct numerical matrix edit without gradients or optimizer.
selection: Choose source-position layer by reciprocal present/absent patch effect on development only. Choose dose by full 36-case development outcomes, prioritizing false supported-act claims, then complete matches, then missed supported acts, then uncertainty errors. Always evaluate frozen best candidate once, even if development gate fails, and report that failure.
controls: Original quantized, conversion-only sham, fixed selected edit, equal-norm random selected-column edit, equal-norm generic-true readout edit, reversed edit, and previously frozen Boolean projection.
freshPolicy: Freeze complete corpus before tracing. No test outcome may select layer, columns, dose, control or prompt. All inspected sets become regression data.
privacy: Offline invented text only. No personal archives, capture, UI tests, production weights/settings or external inference.
caveat: New semantic diagnostic schema is not the production contribution task; verify transfer separately. Agent-authored labels are not independent validation.
